messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Malayalam → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|----------------------------------------|--------| | Tant' | “so, to such a degree” | **അത്ര** | “so” | OK | | è (1) | copula “is” (linking *amara*) | **ഉണ്ടു** (embedded in *കയ്പ്പുള്ളതാണു*) | “is” | OK | | amara | “bitter” | **കയ്പ്പുള്ളതു** | “bitter” | OK | | che | comparative subordinator “that / than” | **അതിനേക്കാൾ** | “than it” | OK | | poco | “little, slightly” | **അല്‍പം** | “a little” | OK | | è (2) | copula in comparative clause | **മാത്രമേ** (part of *മാത്രമേ കൂടുതലുള്ളൂ*) | “only” (functions as the verb “is” here) | OK | | più | comparative “more” | **കൂടുതലുള്ളൂ** | “more” | OK | | morte | “death” | **മരണം** | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating “but” | **എന്നാൽ** | “but / however” | OK | | per | preposition of purpose “in order to” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Malayalam expresses purpose with the infinitive suffix) | | trattar | infinitive “to treat / discuss” | **സംസാരിക്കാൻ** | “to speak / to discuss” | OK | | del | partitive article “of the” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (no article in Malayalam) | | ben | “the good” | **നല്ലത്** | “the good” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun + subject “that I” | **ഞാൻ** | “I” | OK | | vi | locative adverb “there” | **അവിടെ** | “there” | OK | | trovai | past “found” | **കണ്ടെത്തിയ** | “found” | OK | | dirò | future “I will tell” | **പറയും** | “will tell” | OK | | de | preposition “of” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | l'altre | adjective “other (plural)” | **മറ്റ്** | “other” | OK | | cose | noun “things” | **കാര്യങ്ങളെ** | “things (object)” | OK | | ch'i' (2) | relative pronoun + subject “that I” | **ഞാൻ** | “I” | OK | | v' | clitic locative “there” | **അവിടെ** | “there” | OK | | ho | auxiliary “have” (perfect) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | scorte | past participle “seen” | **കണ്ട** | “seen / found” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `per`, `del`, `de`, `ho` – these function words/articles are naturally omitted in Malayalam and do not affect meaning. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 7: - Original: ഇത് അത്ര കയ്പ്പുള്ളതാണു മരണം അതിനേക്കാൾ അല്‍പം മാത്രമേ കൂടുതലുള്ളൂ; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 8: - Original: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ അവിടെ കണ്ടെത്തിയ നല്ലതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് സംസാരിക്കാൻ, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 9: - Original: ഞാൻ അവിടെ കണ്ട മറ്റ് കാര്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് പറയും. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
```malayalam ഇത് അത്ര കയ്പ്പുള്ളതാണു മരണം അതിനേക്കാൾ അല്പം മാത്രമേ കൂടുതലുള്ളു; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ അവിടെ കണ്ടെത്തിയ നല്ലതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് സംസാരിക്കാൻ, ഞാൻ അവിടെ കണ്ട മറ്റുള്ള കാര്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് പറയും. ```
